verdict.rationale: Angular is an open-source web framework and toolchain, not a hosted service that holds user data, so an AI-training opt-out is outside its product category. The CLI usage-metrics setting (angular-docs-28) controls telemetry collection, not AI training use of data. It is an adjacent control and does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
